name: Damage Incorporated
caption: "The Ace" Alex Porteaux and "Mad Dog" Eddy Ramos, managed by Jeandra; billed as having beaten three other teams to reach the ICW World Tag Team Championship tournament final, where they lost to Boxoffice Bound after Zulu Nation interference.

tenures.note: "The Ace" Alex Porteaux and "Mad Dog" Eddy Ramos, managed by Jeandra; billed as having beaten three other teams to reach the ICW World Tag Team Championship tournament final, where they lost to Boxoffice Bound after Zulu Nation interference.

identity.note: Exact name match to an AGW tag team of two entirely different named wrestlers (Nelson and Eric Von Doom); no shared operator, roster or federation fact links the two beyond the common stable name.

name: Boxoffice Bound
caption: "Romeo" Ron Tenille and Don Juan Herrera; won the ICW World Tag Team Championship tournament final over Damage Incorporated after Zulu Nation interference, becoming the belt's first champions.

tenures.note: "Romeo" Ron Tenille and Don Juan Herrera; won the ICW World Tag Team Championship tournament final over Damage Incorporated after Zulu Nation interference, becoming the belt's first champions.

name: The Phoenix Squad
caption: Curt Crane and Brian Anthony, managed by Fara Phoenix; Anthony challenged for the North American title and Crane for the Light-Heavyweight/Cruiserweight title on the same card, both billed as the group's bid to sweep the night's gold.

name: Zulu Nation
caption: Megadeath and Lasana Damani, who ran in during the ICW World Tag Team Championship tournament final, chair-shotted both members of Damage Incorporated to set up Boxoffice Bound's pinfall win, and were named among the fed's own drawing tag teams in its October 1997 comeback plug.

tenures.note: Interference in the ICW World Tag Team Championship tournament final that decided the title.
